tests/krusgraph_checks/fct_campaign__act:
-- From Krusgraph's amount check (validate_plan, amount_levels): Campaign.ActualCost is an amount of the whole Campaign row, repeated on every Lead row in a join (Lead.CampaignId -> Campaign.Id, rule SAP pack); lines per header not counted.
-- From Krusgraph's amount check (validate_plan, amount_levels): Campaign.ActualCost is an amount of the whole Campaign row, repeated on every Opportunity row in a join (Opportunity.CampaignId -> Campaign.Id, rule SAP pack); lines per header not counted.
-- From Krusgraph's amount check (validate_plan, amount_levels): Campaign.ActualCost is an amount of the whole Campaign row, repeated on every CampaignMember row in a join (CampaignMember.CampaignId -> Campaign.Id, rule SAP pack); lines per header not counted.
-- fct_campaign has one row per Campaign row. Returns the two sums of actual_cost when the mart's differs from Campaign's own; passes when it returns none.
-- A mart that joins the lines and carries actual_cost on each of them sums it once per line, and its total comes out larger.
select m.[total] as [mart_total], h.[total] as [campaign_total]
from (select sum(cast([actual_cost] as decimal(38, 4))) as [total] from {{ ref('fct_campaign') }}) as m
cross join (select sum(cast([actual_cost] as decimal(38, 4))) as [total] from {{ ref('stg_salesforce__campaign') }}) as h
where abs(coalesce(m.[total], 0) - coalesce(h.[total], 0)) >= 0.01

-- fct_quote has one row per Quote row. Returns the two sums of subtotal when the mart's differs from Quote's own; passes when it returns none.
-- A mart that joins the lines and carries subtotal on each of them sums it once per line, and its total comes out larger.
select m.[total] as [mart_total], h.[total] as [quote_total]
from (select sum(cast([subtotal] as decimal(38, 4))) as [total] from {{ ref('fct_quote') }}) as m
cross join (select sum(cast([subtotal] as decimal(38, 4))) as [total] from {{ ref('stg_salesforce__quote') }}) as h
where abs(coalesce(m.[total], 0) - coalesce(h.[total], 0)) >= 0.01
